mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 3.8% over the prior three months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises above 3.8% in a 3-month window, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals contraction in consumer demand that lowers corporate revenue expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for joint signal falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 during rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 255.0) signals a supply shock that increases input costs and reduces corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 and CPIAUCSL > 255.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index value above 255.0 signals persistent inflation that triggers imminent Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 255.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A real GDP growth rate above 2.0% annualized signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% annually, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate above 3.7% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE > 3.7%, or Rank IC for joint signal falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 102.0 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate investment growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 102.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.
